ncctl [ options ] command [ command_options] [ path ...]
where options are:
where commands are:
list | get              : List the principals on the specified mounts for this audit session. Takes no options.
unset | destroy         : Unset the principals on the specified mounts for this audit session. Takes no options.
set | init              : Set the suplied principal on the specified mounts for this audit session. Options:
	-F, --force     : Set the principal even if it does not exist in the kerberos cache collection.
	-p, --principal : Set the given principal --principal[=]<principal>
			  on the mounts specified. This option is required.

	If no paths are specifed, act on all currently mounted NFS file systems.
	-v, --verbose   : Verbose output.
	-P, --nofollow  : If a path argument is given that is a symbolic link, do not follow
			  the link, but use the link itself to determine the mount point.
